"

Duties




Investigate and respond to cybersecurity incidents, threats, and vulnerabilities.

Plan and Develop automation scripts for security Ops automation workflow/agents leveraging genAI and engg best practices

Perform log analysis, threat hunting, and root cause analysis.

Conduct vulnerability assessments and coordinate remediation activities.

Implement and maintain security policies, procedures, and best practices.

Collaborate with DevOps and infrastructure teams to secure cloud environments.

Monitor security alerts and events using security monitoring tools.

Stay updated with emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and security technologies.

Skills




Strong Scripting/automation expertise using Python, ansible, terraform, bash.

Familiarity with cloud security concepts (AWS/Azure).

Knowledge of Linux /Debian administration.

Good understanding of security frameworks and compliance standards.

Use of GenAI workflows in day to day work.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and communication skills.

Strong understanding of cybersecurity concepts and security operations.

Experience with security monitoring tools.

Education




B.E or B.Tech or MCA or equivalent.

minimum 3-5 years of experience
